summary: Factorial Energy Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the consummation of a business combination between Cartesian Growth Corp III (SPAC) and Factorial Inc., whereby CGC domesticated to Delaware, merged Merger Sub into Factorial, and Factorial became a wholly-owned subsidiary of the registrant. The transaction closed on June 5, 2026. No per-share price, premium, or implied value is stated; the filing notes the merger agreement dates December 17, 2025, with two amendments. Board recommendation is not detailed. Structurally, the SPAC de-SPAC'd with a domestication and reverse merger, creating a publicly listed operating company. Watch for post-close warrant conversions and lockup expirations; risk-arb focuses on redemption levels and trading liquidity.
